item.description:
Dax 3.4.2

  • “Open only the folder you’re in” is on by default for new setups and settings without a saved choice. Existing choices are preserved.
  • The empty window focuses on its folder button and keyboard-shortcuts link. The new-project instruction and Powered by footer are removed.
  • Ask AI starts new conversations with web search enabled. You can still change the mode during a conversation.
  • Screen snipping clears the Dax palette backdrop before capturing and keeps it clear through selection, completion, and cancellation. This covers Ask AI, Image Ask, and Generate Image.
  • The New Panel picker has the updated robot icon for Agents.
  • The browser’s HTTPS lock opens passkey guidance and an explicit Safari handoff. Native arbitrary-site passkeys inside Dax still require Apple’s managed browser entitlement approval; this release does not claim in-app Touch ID registration.
  • Retains 3.4.1’s mouse scroll control, improved Scoop accent contrast, and paused graphical chat and lid-close support.

Coming from the previous Dax app identity? Install DaxPro with the DMG or PKG. Existing DaxPro installations can update through the new feed.

Existing macOS sleep settings remain unchanged. Previous lid-helper users can review the 3.4.1 recovery guidance.
